name: Youjo ~Yui~ Honnou to Risei no Hazama de
original_name: 養女～結衣～本能と理性の狭間で
source:
A father is sexually aroused toward his stepdaughter whose body has grown nubile.
Will his immoral desires come true?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE219222.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
眼看繼女的身體漸漸發育成熟，父親竟開始對她產生性慾。這份違背倫理的慾望會成真嗎？
